summary: MMA.INC, the NYSE American-listed Mixed Martial Arts Group Limited, filed a Form 6-K disclosing completion of a US$4.0 million private placement of 4,000,000 ordinary shares at US$1.00 per share to a Texas-based family office investing through affiliated entities, approximately 160% above the US$0.38 closing price on August 19, 2026. The financing is common equity only, with no warrants, options, convertible securities, placement agent, finder, or commissions. Shares are restricted under Rule 144; proceeds fund working capital. Not a special situation; watch for dilution and any resale registration.
